title: A closed immersion factors through another iff the ideal sheaves are included
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $i:Z\to X$, $i':Z'\to X$ closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion] with ideal sheaves $\mathcal I=\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i_*\mathcal O_Z)$ and $\mathcal I'=\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i'_*\mathcal O_{Z'})$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Then there is a morphism of schemes $a:Z\to Z'$ with $i'\circ a=i$ if and only if $\mathcal I'\subseteq\mathcal I$; and if this holds, $a$ is a closed immersion.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 01QP (morphisms-lemma-closed-immersion-ideals), part (1); its proof refers to Schemes, Lemmas 01HO (schemes-lemma-closed-immersion) and 01HP (schemes-lemma-characterize-closed-subspace)

mathlib_match.how: a few Mathlib lemmas, one per clause, with ideal sheaves i.ker, i'.ker (Scheme.Hom.ker, the match of def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf): if i'.ker ≤ i.ker, a = IsClosedImmersion.lift i' i H (:210) satisfies a ≫ i' = i (lift_fac, :215); conversely, if a ≫ i' = i then i'.ker ≤ (a ≫ i').ker = i.ker (Hom.le_ker_comp, Basic.lean:732); a is a closed immersion by of_comp_isClosedImmersion a i' (:132), since a ≫ i' = i and i' are closed immersions.
